subject.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to double for md tag

question: Which Feishu newline-fix branch should maintainers treat as canonical before merge, and should this branch be repaired or paused?
rationale: The remaining choice combines message-delivery upgrade risk, missing contributor proof on this branch, and multiple overlapping PRs including one proof-sufficient but currently conflicting sibling.

options.title: Repair this branch and require proof
options.body: Make normalization length-safe across send, reply, and edit paths on this branch, then require redacted live Feishu/Lark proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt a proof-positive sibling after conflict repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99394 as the canonical fix only after it is cleanly mergeable and maintainers accept its fanout behavior.

options.title: Pause overlapping branches
options.body: Keep this PR open but paused while maintainers choose a single canonical implementation for the linked Feishu bug.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch and require proof
recommendation.body: Make normalization length-safe across send, reply, and edit paths on this branch, then require redacted live Feishu/Lark proof before merge.
